topic: A feathered dinosaur tail in amber
script: In 2016, scientists described a feathered dinosaur tail trapped in amber. The amber is about 99 million years old. The tail likely belonged to a young, small meat-eating dinosaur. Amber is fossilized tree resin that can trap insects, plants and even small animals. It can preserve details too tiny to see without a microscope. But scientists have never recovered dinosaur DNA from amber. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
